title: If you're scared, start here.
transcript_body: Hi. I'm Dr. Gabriella. If you're reading this, you're probably thinking about calling a dentist — and probably putting it off. I get it. I see anxious patients every week, and here's what I want you to know: the first visit is mostly a conversation. We talk. You tell me what's going on, what scares you, what happened before. I listen. Then we look together — radiographs, exam, photos. Only after that do we talk about a plan, in writing, with costs and timelines. You're not committing to anything by writing me on WhatsApp. You're just starting a conversation. We go at your pace. If you need to stop, we stop. I hope to hear from you.
